clips.title: The story
paras: “Auntie” Bernice Stonefield is an elder of the Stonefield family, residing at their homestead in south-central Elwynn Forest. Widowed after her husband fell in battle during the kingdom's military campaigns, she is renowned throughout the valley for her famous pork belly pies. She can be found outside the farmhouse alongside Ma Stonefield, keeping a sharp eye on the neighborhood and harboring a deep suspicion of the rival Maclure family.

Like many common folk across the Kingdom of Stormwind, Bernice has borne the steep price of ongoing war. Having lost her husband to military campaigns, she now lives out her days on the family homestead with her kin, helping manage daily farm affairs alongside matriarch Ma Stonefield. Despite personal loss, she keeps the household fed and running, earning local fame for her celebrated pork belly pies.
